name_story.story: Fitri can be understood through the Arabic form فِطْرِي, whose central sense is fitri; natural, innate (indonesian form). Fitri is the Indonesian form of Arabic فِطْرِيّ (Fiṭrī), meaning 'natural, innate'. It is used as a female given name.

faq.a: Fitri is associated with the Arabic form فِطْرِي, whose core sense is fitri; natural, innate (indonesian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Fitri?
faq.a: Fitri is associated with Arabic. Fitri is the Indonesian form of Arabic فِطْرِيّ (Fiṭrī), meaning 'natural, innate'. It is used as a female given name.
Yes — the underlying form فِطْرِي is Arabic.
Fitri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Fitri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ف ط ر is Quranic, but Fiṭrī is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Fitri mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Fitri is rendered فطری and carries the sense فطری، قدرتی.

faq.q: What does Fitri mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Fitri is rendered فطری and carries the sense فطری، طبیعی.
A romanized syllable approximation is fit-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Fitri?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Fitri, fitri. Script forms are فطري, فطری, فِطْرِي, फ़ित्री.

faq.q: Is Fitri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
